shared_elements: standing human figure in strict profile
long pleated robe with vertical drapery folds
bearded male figure with styled hair
low-relief carved figures on architectural surface
repeated stylized plant/rosette-like motifs on a band
justification: Both show low-relief bearded male figures in strict profile wearing long pleated robes and holding upright spears/staffs, arranged as parts of a procession along an architectural face, with the same conventions of parallel incised drapery folds, patterned beard and shallow modelling. The main difference is scale and framing of content: A shows a whole staircase facade with rows of small figures and a band of repeated stylized foliate motifs above, while B isolates a single large guard figure with an additional quiver and a fluted headdress rendered in detail.
